mapper.insert: INSERT INTO req_doc_comment (id, workspace_id, doc_id, user_id, content, quote_text, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{docId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{quoteText}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, doc_id, user_id, content, quote_text, created_at, updated_at FROM req_doc_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, workspace_id, doc_id, user_id, content, quote_text, created_at, updated_at FROM req_doc_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM req_doc_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM req_doc_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
